expected.title: pac solution pack places Quick Create forms under <forms type="quick" />
steps_to_reproduce: Create a solution, add a table and create a new Quick Create form
Add an 'onLoad' event handler to the new Quick Create form
Use the Power Platform source control integration to commit the solution to git
Navigate to the solution root folder and run `pac solution pack --folder ./ --zipfile QuickCreateForm.zip --packageType managed`
Attempt to import the example.zip managed solution file into another environment
Manually unzip the QuickCreateForm.zip solution file and view the customizations.xml file
expected.expected_result: When packing YAML solution source, Quick Create form definitions should go under <forms type='quickCreate'> only
expected.actual_result: the resulting solution.zip duplicates the Quick Create form definition under <forms type='quick'> as well as <forms type='quickCreate'>; solution imports fail when the quick create form contains an <events /> definition

notes: версія pac cli з розділу Desktop
